dishes.name: Slow-cooked beef chili with mushrooms and kidney beans

recipe.name: Slow-cooked beef chili with mushrooms and kidney beans

ingredients.name: 1 kg beef chuck, in 3 cm cubes
2 tsp ground cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika (gluten free)

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in a heavy pot with a little oil, season with salt and pepper.
Soften the onions, then the mushrooms and garlic, 8 minutes.
Add the spices and chili flakes for a minute, then the tomatoes, the beef and 2 dl water.
Cover and simmer on low for 2 to 2.5 hours until the beef is tender, stirring now and then.
Add the beans for the last 20 minutes. Season and serve with rice.

dishes.name: Chicken, tofu and zucchini stir fry with mushrooms, ginger and garlic

recipe.name: Chicken, tofu and zucchini stir fry with mushrooms, ginger and garlic

ingredients.name: 2 packs firm tofu (400 g), in cubes, patted dry
900 g skinless chicken breast fillet, in strips
3 cloves garlic, a thumb of ginger, grated
4 tbsp Mrs Chang or Pearl River Bridge mushroom soy (gluten free, at home)
1 tbsp cornflour (majsstärkelse), 1 tsp sugar, chili flakes

steps.text: Fry the tofu in oil until golden on all sides, set aside.
Fry the chicken strips over high heat until cooked through, set aside.
Fry the zucchini until browned, then the onion and mushrooms.
Add garlic and ginger for a minute.
Mix the soy, sugar, chili and cornflour with 1 dl water, pour in and let it thicken.
Return the tofu and chicken, toss and serve with rice.

dishes.name: Coconut chicken and butternut curry with rice

recipe.name: Coconut chicken and butternut curry with rice

steps.text: Cube the butternut and chop the onion. Grate the ginger and garlic.
Brown the chicken in a pot, set aside. Soften the onion, ginger, garlic and chili flakes.
Add the butternut, chicken and coconut milk. Simmer 25 to 30 minutes until tender.
Finish with lime juice and zest and salt. Serve with rice.
